§0 HOW TO READ THIS
Pipe-delimited records across 5 biophysical layers and 4 functional tiers.
Layers: 1=Allosteric/PTM Switches, 2=Direct Molecular Functions, 3=Cellular Signaling Cascades, 4=Tissue Pathologies, 5=Systemic Clinical Phenotypes.
Tiers: 1=Regulation, 2=Function, 3=Cellular Consequence, 4=Clinical Outcome.
Evidence Grades: S=Demonstrated for SAMHD1, G=Established elsewhere, I=Inferred / Computational.
Loss: Quantitative predicted functional activity loss in A565T heterozygotes (e.g. 0.75 = 75% loss, 0.35 = 35% loss).

SAMHD1 deficiency causes excessive telomere lengthening in telomerase-positive cells and telomere instability contributing to both cancer risk and cellular aging

psa-phenotype | Psoriatic Arthritis & Synovial Enthesitis | L4 | systemic | clinical | immune | G | 0.0 | Active Auto-inflammatory Disease | Systemic inflammatory manifestation linked to loss of NF-κB and IRF7 suppression | Chronic auto-inflammatory arthropathy driven by unrestrained IL-17A, TNF, and Type I IFN signaling at entheses and synovial membranes; responds rapidly to JAK inhibitor therapy (tofacitinib/upadacitinib)
interferonopathy-ags | Type I Interferonopathy / AGS-like Spectrum | L5 | systemic | clinical | immune | S | 0.0 | Haploinsufficient Interferonopathy | Prototypical systemic outcome of SAMHD1 genetic deficiency (Rice et al. 2009); foundation of the clinical autoinflammatory phenotype | Constitutive interferon-stimulated gene (ISG) transcriptional signature driven by chronic cytosolic DNA (mtDNA/micronuclei) and dsRNA sensing; phenotypic spectrum spanning Aicardi-Goutières syndrome (AGS5) to adult-onset lupus-like autoimmunity

dntpase | sphase | maintains | S | The dNTP pool is the substrate supply for replication; SAMHD1 holds it in the narrow band S phase requires. Excess is as damaging as scarcity.
